POTION.AMBERGRIS.name: Ambergris
POTION.AMBERGRIS.blurb: Heal for 50% of your max HP. If used in combat, take an extra turn.

POTION.ASHWATER.name: Ashwater
POTION.ASHWATER.blurb: Exhaust any number of cards in your Hand.

POTION.ATTACK_POTION.name: Attack Potion
POTION.ATTACK_POTION.blurb: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

POTION.BEETLE_JUICE.name: Beetle Juice
POTION.BEETLE_JUICE.blurb: Enemy's attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 4 turns.

POTION.BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.name: Blessing of the Forge
POTION.BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.blurb: Upgrade all cards in your Hand for the rest of combat.

POTION.BLOOD_POTION.name: Blood Potion
POTION.BLOOD_POTION.blurb: Heal for 20% of your Max HP.

POTION.BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.name: Bottled Potential
POTION.BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.blurb: Shuffle ALL your cards into your Draw Pile. Draw 5 cards.

POTION.CLARITY_EXTRACT.name: Clarity Extract
POTION.CLARITY_EXTRACT.blurb: Draw 1 card. At the start of your next 3 turns, draw 1 additional card.

POTION.COLORLESS_POTION.name: Colorless Potion
POTION.COLORLESS_POTION.blurb: Choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

POTION.COSMIC_CONCOCTION.name: Cosmic Concoction
POTION.COSMIC_CONCOCTION.blurb: Add 3 Upgraded Colorless cards into your Hand.

POTION.DISTILLED_CHAOS.name: Distilled Chaos
POTION.DISTILLED_CHAOS.blurb: Play the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile.

POTION.DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.name: Droplet of Precognition
POTION.DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.blurb: Choose a card in your Draw Pile and add it into your Hand.

POTION.DUPLICATOR.name: Duplicator
POTION.DUPLICATOR.blurb: This turn, your next card is played an extra time.

POTION.ENTROPIC_BREW.name: Entropic Brew
POTION.ENTROPIC_BREW.blurb: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.

POTION.ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.name: Essence of Darkness
POTION.ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS.blurb: Channel a Dark for each of your Orb Slots.

POTION.FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Fairy in a Bottle
POTION.FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.blurb: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.

POTION.FLEX_POTION.name: Flex Potion
POTION.FLEX_POTION.blurb: Gain 5 Strength. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Strength.

POTION.FOUL_POTION.name: Foul Potion
POTION.FOUL_POTION.blurb:
Deal 12 damage to EVERYONE.
Can be thrown at the Merchant for 100 Gold instead.

POTION.GAMBLERS_BREW.name: Gambler's Brew
POTION.GAMBLERS_BREW.blurb: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

POTION.GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.name: Gigantification Potion
POTION.GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.blurb: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.

POTION.LIQUID_MEMORIES.name: Liquid Memories
POTION.LIQUID_MEMORIES.blurb: Put a card from your Discard Pile into your Hand. It costs 0 1 Energy this turn.

POTION.OROBIC_ACID.name: Orobic Acid
POTION.OROBIC_ACID.blurb: Add a random Attack, Skill, and Power into your Hand. They're free to play this turn.

POTION.POTION_OF_BINDING.name: Potion of Binding
POTION.POTION_OF_BINDING.blurb: Apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

POTION.POWDERED_DEMISE.name: Powdered Demise
POTION.POWDERED_DEMISE.blurb: Enemy loses 9 HP at the end of each of its turns.

POTION.POWER_POTION.name: Power Potion
POTION.POWER_POTION.blurb: Choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

POTION.RADIANT_TINCTURE.name: Radiant Tincture
POTION.RADIANT_TINCTURE.blurb: Gain 1 Energy. Gain an additional 1 Energy at the start of your next 3 turns.

POTION.SHACKLING_POTION.name: Shackling Potion
POTION.SHACKLING_POTION.blurb: ALL enemies lose 7 Strength this turn.

POTION.SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Ship in a Bottle
POTION.SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.blurb: Gain 10 Block. Next turn, gain 10 Block.

POTION.SKILL_POTION.name: Skill Potion
POTION.SKILL_POTION.blurb: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

POTION.SNECKO_OIL.name: Snecko Oil
POTION.SNECKO_OIL.blurb: Draw 7 cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your Hand this turn.

POTION.SOLDIERS_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew
POTION.SOLDIERS_STEW.blurb: All cards containing {{2|Strike}} gain 1 Replay this combat.

POTION.SPEED_POTION.name: Speed Potion
POTION.SPEED_POTION.blurb: Gain 5 Dexterity. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Dexterity.

POTION.TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.name: Touch of Insanity
POTION.TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.blurb: Choose a card in your Hand. It is free to play this combat.
